name: Shana Feste
bio: Shana Feste is an American writer, director, and producer.  Feste is best known for writing the screenplay for and directing the hit feature film, Country Strong (2010), starring Gwyneth Paltrow. She also wrote and directed, The Greatest (2009).

credits.title: Heartland
credits.overview: A former country star, Misty Jones, comes out of seclusion to investigate the disappearance of her missing niece, a rising country musician and must grapple with her own past and Nashville’s seedy underbelly. Her search uncovers a murky side of Nashville where no one, including Misty, is who they seem.

credits.title: Run Sweetheart Run
credits.overview: A woman runs for her life though the streets of Los Angeles after her blind date suddenly turns violent.

credits.title: Boundaries
credits.overview: Single mom Laura, along with her awkward 14 year-old son Henry is forced to drive Jack, her estranged, care-free pot dealing father across country after he's kicked out of yet another nursing home.
